answer: In clinical trials, R21/Matrix-M reached 77% effectiveness in Phase 2 [2]. Phase 3 trials showed 12-month vaccine efficacy of 75% at seasonal sites and 68% at standard sites [2]. Efficacy against multiple clinical malaria episodes was 75% at seasonal sites and 67% at standard sites [2]. The vaccine is described as offering up to 77% protection against the malaria parasite in clinical trials [2].
